summary: Source re-review recovered Table 1 and Table S3 MIC rows, rechecked database rows against paper-local XML/supplement/database snapshots, preserved non-DBAASP database text conflicts, and closed the prior worker-6 rework target without promoting unresolved database text to primary evidence.
adjudication_summary: Worker-6 accepts the paper as publication-grade with cautions after worker-2 activity repair and worker-4 database adjudication; no blocking rework target remains.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material remains a separate packet layer: XML, article PDF text, OA package, s001 supplement text, locators, and database snapshots are available and sufficient for this targeted analysis repair.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Validator contract remains distinct from publication-grade review; strict semantic/publication gates are rerun after this repair.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 reviewed 110 database-linked rows. DBAASP rows are source-located; CAMP/dbAMP text rows are preserved as source_conflict or database_only_no_primary_source cautions rather than smoothed into source_verified.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repaired the missing activity layer with 34 MIC rows from Table 1 and Table S3. No current-paper toxicity row was fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication accepts membrane-potential/proton-translocation evidence with scope guards and preserves the unresolved carrier/channel question.
per_layer_decision_rationale.final_review: The previous ticket rwk-complete-test-0001 is resolved because source review is now explicit, rework_targets is empty, and remaining uncertainties are nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.note: The packet has no linked_sequence_records rows; sequence/name/modified cyclic notation was adjudicated from Table 1/Table S3 plus merged all_sequences.csv. Lowercase/D-amino-acid and X/Pra modified notation was preserved rather than normalized.
CAMP/dbAMP text rows are retained as provenance but not promoted to primary activity evidence.

DBAASP rows are the source-reviewed current-paper linked rows. CAMP/dbAMP rows remain cautionary because they mix current-paper links with database text and, for natural lugdunin, older broad-spectrum values outside this 2019 paper.

caution_findings.note: Mechanism is accepted for membrane potential/proton translocation evidence; the paper leaves carrier versus channel formation unresolved.
The 2019 paper provides MIC activity rows and membrane/mechanism assays; no current-paper hemolysis/cytotoxicity table was recovered or invented.
